title: The Clever Fox
text:
Once upon a time, a fox lived near a river. He was small, but he was very clever. Every day he looked for food in the forest. One day he saw a big cake on a table.

The fox wanted the cake, but the cake was in a house. He thought for a long time. Then he had a good idea. He made a loud noise, and the farmer ran outside. The fox quickly ate the cake.

questions.text: What did the fox see one day?
Why did the farmer run outside?
options: He wanted to eat the cake
He wanted to play with the fox
He was looking for his dog

questions.text: How did the fox feel when the farmer ran outside?

vocabulary.definition: able to think and learn quickly
a thought about what to do
a sound, often a loud one

paragraph_translations: Era uma vez uma raposa que morava perto de um rio. Ele era pequeno, mas muito esperto. Todos os dias ele procurava comida na floresta. Um dia ele viu um bolo grande em cima de uma mesa.

A raposa queria o bolo, mas o bolo estava dentro de uma casa. Ele pensou por muito tempo. Então teve uma boa ideia. Ele fez um barulho alto, e o fazendeiro saiu correndo. A raposa comeu o bolo rapidamente.
